audit_method: Read-only mathematical/source review; original published content002 statistics and parameter-update fields were independently recomputed/checked. No frozen Python source was changed and the running 70-job matrix was not inspected.
summary_zh: 语义合同与标量再生控制模型成立，有限生成元传播和局部一阶梯度有独立核验；有限网格/任务最优性不成立为既有结论，已发表机制优势门仍未通过。当前加速实验只检验实现保真与计算成本。

stages.title: Typed event/value semantics and chronology
completed: C=E[N_s] is repeated expected firing count; P=Pr(N_s>=1) includes the declared complete initial state; F is a frozen first-passage CDF for a specified active start; f is its continuous density with atoms accounted separately; H_rho is discounted first-event mass; K is the immediate firing cost.

J^pi and G^pi are policy and immediate-intervention values with reset continuation. G is neither default probability nor a literal financial Put. Neither value channel has a mathematically fixed restoring/panic-force sign.

A boundary shrink emits covered active mass at time zero and rewards its original position. Existing refractory stages persist. All later reset cycles count; zero-phase self-reset events remain marked events.
The trained model retains eight active cells and two Erlang phase masses. Physical model time is 0.1 times input dt; it is distinct from hardware seconds and native-owner ticks.
limits: These are continuous probability/expectation messages, not sampled binary biological spikes or neuromorphic event executions.
Finite lower reflection, coarse spatial cells, piecewise-uniform moving-boundary remaps and finite Erlang duration variance remain explicit modeling approximations.
P and F coincide only when the event, start, filtration, boundary jump and refractory conventions coincide. A terminal exceedance probability cannot replace a first-passage CDF.
Smooth pasting applies to the value problem; it does not make CDF atoms, reset knots or the complete hybrid network globally smooth.
The failed original v1 mean-state closure and failed raw 4096-step probability audit remain preserved; neither is retroactively reclassified by v2 or the stable profile.

stages.title: Regenerative Bellman/QVI, implicit boundary gradient, and finite-grid mismatch

scalar_contract.domain: sigma>0, rho>0, r<K, tau>=0; stationary arithmetic Brownian active state on the unbounded line; affine firing reward x-K; adapted nonaccumulating impulse controls
scalar_contract.gradient: db/dtheta=-Psi_theta/Psi_b, with the full chain rule for constrained and effective-delay parameterizations
scalar_contract.validity: The source verifies both global QVI inequalities and transversality for this scalar problem; value matching and smooth pasting alone would not establish optimality.
scalar_contract.excluded: Higher derivatives through the detached root, sigma=0 or rho=0 diffusion formulas, near-chattering uniform conditioning, moving/input-dependent policies and task-specific optimality are not certified.

published_scalar_numerical_checks.scope: Published source-bound results reviewed here; not rerun as new experiments.

finite_model_contract.delay: For m Erlang stages, D=(nu/(nu+rho))^m with nu=m/tau. Equivalent tau_eff=m/rho*log(1+rho*tau/m) matches only the discount factor in the continuous boundary calculation.
finite_model_contract.active_first_hit: (rho I-A) h=lambda_active; h_r=sum_i w_i(r) h_i, where A is the killed backward active generator.
finite_model_contract.intervention: G_i=x_i-K+D*J_r on active cells; G_phase,j=J_phase,j during mandatory refractory continuation.
finite_model_contract.Bellman_scope: With column probability generator Q, (rho I-Q^T)J=(b-K)*lambda. This is own-policy evaluation, not a maximized finite-state Bellman equation.
finite_model_contract.surrogate_boundary: The Brownian/Erlang b is not the finite reflecting grid optimum; replacing J with an optimal grid value without changing the controlled event law/reward would be inconsistent.

finite_grid_counterexamples.interpretation: A sampled feasible boundary has higher own-policy value, establishing a lower bound on suboptimality. The best sampled boundary is not certified globally optimal, and these returns are not classification or owner returns.

current_backend_acceptance.source_identity: All five source hashes recorded by validation001 were rechecked against the current restored bytes and match.
current_backend_acceptance.scope: Selected cases support faithful finite-model polynomial evaluation and local first derivatives. They do not certify global floating-point/gradient bounds, spatial accuracy of arbitrary parameters, or a mechanism advantage.

stages.title: Joint training versus causal contribution and predictive advantage

training_evidence.propagation_path_test: The frozen v2 model integration test detaches direct physical-parameter gate features and all analytic feature inputs; task CE gradients still reach the four physical groups through retained probability propagation. This demonstrates a local computational path, not a benefit in predictive quality.
training_evidence.limits: Finite nonzero gradients and observed parameter updates establish trainability. They do not prove the implicit affine-reward boundary is task-optimal, that every parameter is necessary, or that training the full physical system improves quality.

published_contribution_results.interpretation: The boundary, dual-value and active-distribution comparisons did not pass their positive advantage gates. This is not evidence of equivalence or of zero functional effect. The independent ordinary gated network had a significant negative free-model difference in the declared two-task, eight-seed comparison.
published_contribution_results.statistical_scope: Each seed averages the same two fixed tasks; the exact sign-flip family contains four contrasts. Nominal t intervals are not simultaneous intervals, and these tasks are not a random population of all modalities.
published_contribution_results.heldout_scope: These published datasets had already been observed in earlier studies; the result is not fresh-test confirmation.

missing_or_separate_tests: The reviewed model arm lists do not contain a complete freeze-one-physical-group factorial establishing which of jointly trained drift, discount/cost, reset and refractory pathways produces task benefit.
The v2 arm list is not a full margin -> J-only -> J+G -> explicit first-event-risk feature ladder. G must not be renamed a default-risk feature.
Fixed/direct/conditional thresholds, ordinary physical features, active-mean collapse and independent two_gates isolate different interventions and must not be pooled as the same ablation.
The new 70-job matrix contains hcsn_reference, hcsn_accelerated, two_gates, transformer and lif_snn; it does not introduce a new mechanism-ablation family.
stages.current_experiment_interpretation: The reference/accelerated pair shares generator, value equation, stable profile and learned parameter shapes. Any faithful speed improvement supports implementation efficiency only. Its result cannot retrospectively change the failed mechanism gates.
